items.title: Drag the clock. Watch a deterministic test stay deterministic.
items.description: Reproduces L3's exact isTrialExpired check with a stub clock in place of the real system time. The trial end date is fixed at June 1, 2026 (like L3's expiredUser) — drag the stub clock's date across the timeline and watch the result flip exactly once, at the trial's own boundary, regardless of what today's real date happens to be.
